text:
Maya R.: fyi support got two tickets where clients hit a 413 from the fastpath splitter with no guidance. high churn.
Jessica L.: we should send structured error payloads. minimal: `{ code: \"embed_oversize\", reason: \"mixed_dims\", hint: \"call /v1/embeddings/preflight or set X-Embed-AutoSplit\" }`
Arun P.: runtime note 2 the splitter can offer a slowpath fallback but we short-circuit when client fast-fails. options: change fallback behavior, or keep runtime and improve client ergonomics.
Ryan H.: SDK plan: on 413 + embed_oversize -> auto-call /v1/embeddings/preflight, then resend chunked requests. opt-in header `X-Embed-AutoSplit: true` to avoid surprising older clients. I'll prototype py/ts today.
Sam K.: console: small "Fix 413s" card on route page when 413 spike detected. show suggested split, sample curl, and one-click preflight modal. also a link to support runbook.
deploy-bot: canary deploy `embed-splitter:v2` -> us-west-2 (25%).
Jessica L.: spec: add `error.hint_type` values: `preflight`, `dimension_hint`, `bytes_hint`. include `expected_dims` array where available. document and semver.
Arun P.: add header `x-embed-splitter-reason: mixed-dims;preferred_split=1536` to help proxies. runtime already emits preferred_split in traces.
Ryan H.: metrics: emit `embed.fastpath.reject_reason` tag (mixed_dims/bytes/unparsable) and `embed.preflight.offered` gauge. Sam: add grafana queries: `sum(rate(embed_requests_total{status=\"413\"}[5m])) by (route)` and `ratio(sum(rate(embed_requests_total{status=\"413\"}[5m])), sum(rate(embed_requests_total[5m])))` with drilldown by `embed.fastpath.reject_reason`.
Maya R.: owners: Ryan -> SDK PR/tests by EOD; Jessica+Arun -> spec + docs; Sam -> console mock by Fri. I'll open a short support runbook. sync tomorrow 11am to close. :thumbsup:
